ayahOccurrences.text: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَلْفَحُ is in the derivative form: تَلْفَح
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ل/ف/ح   l–f–ḥ heat of a fire, fire, glare of a fire; to scorch, to burn, to sear, to tan; to strike lightly. Of this root, only تَلْفَح talfaḥ occurs 1 time in the Qu’ran
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَلْفَح talfaḥ [imperf. of v., trans.] to scorch, to burn

(23:104) تَلْفَحُ‏ ‏وُجُوهَهُمُ‏ ‏النَّارُ the Fire will scorch their faces.
